title: Whole Bored Pin and Ribbon Blender Preparation Board
description: One complete static bakery hand-tool preparation-board scene, one new scene zero new independent models. The whole qualified curved five-ribbon pastry blender stands on its existing lower ribbon datum at the front left, leaving a clear empty working area to its right. Both complete objects fit within the board inner footprint with a positive gap along Y. A single continuous scene-only board has two side rims and a rear rim with an open unraised front edge; it is not a separately counted model. Both complete original GLB buffers, POSITION/NORMAL arrays, material dictionaries, face assignments and internal hierarchy remain exact under whole unit-scale translations only; no cropping, extraction, scaling, recolouring or re-counting. Unlike the previous room-scale mixer/dough worktable, this is a compact open-front manual-tool board display. Static empty display only: no dough, mixing, rolling action, kneading, food contact, sanitation, tool performance, ergonomics, loading, manufacture or safety capability. No rigging animation or interaction.
